consequence.statement: No enum values were removed, so existing Prometheus resources that set spec.otlp.translationStrategy are still accepted; the only change is that the new value UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes is now allowed.

original.statement: In the monitoring.coreos.com/v1 Prometheus CRD schema, the enum for spec.otlp.translationStrategy gained the allowed value "UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes" and lost no values, so values accepted before are still accepted.

decision.reason: The computed diff of the Prometheus CRD between [ev-cc90e86e2643] and [ev-c87966ce90d5] lists removed: [] and added: ["UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes"] for spec.otlp.translationStrategy. A value that was valid before is therefore not rejected now, and existing resources keep working. The semvalidate.crd 'tightened' check even found the enum unchanged, which supports no-consequence just as well. Nothing in the evidence says any resource is rejected, any setting is ignored or any behaviour changes, so kind none (informational) is correct, and P2's resource-rejected claim has no support.
